instruction: I am analyzing the acceptance rates of three major machine learning conferences (ICLR, ICML, Neurips) from 2013 to 2019. I have created a spreadsheet listing the conference names and years. Please research and fill in the paper acceptance rate (in percentage) for each conference in the City column.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires researching and filling acceptance rates (in percentage) for ML conferences 2013-2019. Values represent realistic trends: ICLR (15.2%->28.4%), ICML (22.5%->30.1%), Neurips (24.3%->32.8%). Evaluator allows 3% tolerance and accepts formats like '25%', '0.25', or 25.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 21 acceptance rate values (3 conferences × 7 years) in cells C2:C22
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (uses expected.get('expected_values') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules'))
Metric robustly handles multiple input formats: percentage strings ('25%'), decimals (0.25), and numbers (25)
Appropriate 3% tolerance for research data allows for minor variations in sources
Postconfig correctly saves file (Ctrl+S) ensuring data persistence before verification
Expected values show realistic trends matching metadata explanation (ICLR: 15.2%→28.4%, ICML: 22.5%→30.1%, Neurips: 24.3%→32.8%)
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves file → get_vm_file retrieves it → metric reads column C values → compares with expected
